name: remediation-lifecycle-resilience
title: Remediation Lifecycle Resilience
description: Make remediation diagnosis, planning, patching, validation, and publication recover from bounded failures without silently converting recoverable states into manual-review conclusions.
creator: yarns
notes: Architecture spans the full lifecycle, but implementation is staged behind a snapshotted project policy. This task coordinates and supersedes conflicting terminal/context rules in the related remediation subtasks; it does not reopen connector credential or transport contracts.
